title.narrative: ACCESS 2.0 Advancing Capacity for and Coverage of the Essential Services package through Systems Strengthening

description.narrative:
This action supports the delivery of essential services in Primary Health Care Facilities in the municipalities of Suq Aljuma (a municipality satellite of Tripoli), Benghazi (east of LY) and Saba (south of LY).

The global objective of this action is to contribute to the improvement of health outcomes in the Libyan population particularly among those who are most at risk or vulnerable. The specific objective is to improve access to and utilisation of essential health services ensuring equity for vulnerable populations in targeted municipalities.

Direct beneficiaries are conservatively estimated at 150,000 people of the general population that will come in contact with the serves offered along with estimated 300 government staff working in the health facilities. Numbers will be adjusted after the baseline planned for the first quarter of implementation.
